      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SelectMaterials_Send</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendMaterials" name="Send materials to selected friends" messageRef="Message_Materials">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SelectMaterials_Send</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SendMaterials_PostActionsJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_PostActionsJoin" name="Post-farming actions complete">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Brag_PostActionsJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SendMaterials_PostActionsJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PostActions_None</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PostActionsJoin_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:inclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_ProcessComplete" name="Process complete">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PostActionsJoin_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_ChooseResources" sourceRef="StartEvent_CreateBot" targetRef="Task_ChooseResources"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ChooseResources_SetPriorities" sourceRef="Task_ChooseResources" targetRef="Task_SetPriorities"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SetPriorities_DefineDependencies" sourceRef="Task_SetPriorities" targetRef="Task_DefineDependencies"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DefineDependencies_Farming" sourceRef="Task_DefineDependencies" targetRef="SubProcess_Farming"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Farming_SelectFriends" sourceRef="SubProcess_Farming" targetRef="Task_SelectFriends"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SelectFriends_PostActions" sourceRef="Task_SelectFriends" targetRef="Gateway_PostActions"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PostActions_Brag" sourceRef="Gateway_PostActions" targetRef="Task_Brag">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">bragSelected</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PostActions_SendMaterials" sourceRef="Gateway_PostActions" targetRef="Task_SelectMaterials">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">materialsSelected</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PostActions_None" sourceRef="Gateway_PostActions" targetRef="Gateway_PostActionsJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SelectMaterials_Send" sourceRef="Task_SelectMaterials" targetRef="Task_SendMaterials"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Brag_PostActionsJoin" sourceRef="Task_Brag" targetRef="Gateway_PostActionsJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SendMaterials_PostActionsJoin" sourceRef="Task_SendMaterials" targetRef="Gateway_PostActionsJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PostActionsJoin_End" sourceRef="Gateway_PostActionsJoin" targetRef="EndEvent_ProcessComplete"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_FarmingBot">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_FarmingBot" name="Farming Bot process" processRef="Process_FarmingBot"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Friends" name="Selected friends"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Brag" name="Brag" sourceRef="Task_Brag" targetRef="Participant_Friends" messageRef="Message_Brag"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Materials" name="Materials" sourceRef="Task_SendMaterials" targetRef="Participant_Friends" messageRef="Message_Materials"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
</bpmn:definitions>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  targetNamespace="https://example.com/bpmn/farming-bot">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Brag" name="Brag"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Materials" name="Materials"/>
  <bpmn:signal id="Signal_NaturalDisaster" name="Natural disaster"/>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_FarmingBot" name="Farming Bot" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_FarmingBot">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Player" name="Player">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_CreateBot</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ChooseResources</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SetPriorities</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_DefineDependencies</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Brag</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendMaterials</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_PostActions</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_PostActionsJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_ProcessComplete</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Bot" name="Farming bot">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>SubProcess_Farming</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_CreateBot" name="Create a custom farming bot">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Start_ChooseResources</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ChooseResources" name="Choose resources to farm">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Start_ChooseResources</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ChooseResources_SetPriorities</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SetPriorities" name="Set resource priorities">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ChooseResources_SetPriorities</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SetPriorities_DefineDependencies</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_DefineDependencies" name="Define resource and tool dependencies">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SetPriorities_DefineDependencies</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_DefineDependencies_Farming</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:subProcess id="SubProcess_Farming" name="Farm resources">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_DefineDependencies_Farming</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Farming_PostActions</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Farming">
        <bpmn:lane id="Lane_FarmingPlayer" name="Player">
          <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EventSubProcess_UpdateList</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        </bpmn:lane>
        <bpmn:lane id="Lane_FarmingBot" name="Farming bot">
          <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_Farming</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
          <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_FarmResources</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
          <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_FarmingComplete</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
          <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_Farming</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
          <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EventSubProcess_NaturalDisaster</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
          <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EventSubProcess_Milestone</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        </bpmn:lane>
      </bpmn:laneSet>

      <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Farming" name="Start farming">
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_FarmingStart_Farm</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:startEvent>
      <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_FarmResources" name="Farm resources according to priorities and dependencies">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_FarmingStart_Farm</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_FarmingRepeat</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Farm_CompletionCheck</bpmn:outgoing>
        <bpmn:multiInstanceLoopCharacteristics isSequential="false">
          <bpmn:loopCardinality xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">min(numberOfSelectedResources, 10)</bpmn:loopCardinality>
        </bpmn:multiInstanceLoopCharacteristics>
      </bpmn:serviceTask>
      <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_FarmingComplete" name="All selected resources gathered?" default="Flow_FarmingRepeat">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Farm_CompletionCheck</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_FarmingDone</bpmn:outgoing>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_FarmingRepeat</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
      <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Farming" name="Farming finished">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_FarmingDone</bpmn:incoming>
      </bpmn:endEvent>

      <bpmn:subProcess id="EventSubProcess_NaturalDisaster" name="Handle natural disaster" triggeredByEvent="true">
        <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_NaturalDisaster">
          <bpmn:lane id="Lane_DisasterBot" name="Farming bot">
            <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_NaturalDisaster</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
            <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SetBotBack</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
            <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_DisasterHandled</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
          </bpmn:lane>
        </bpmn:laneSet>
        <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_NaturalDisaster" name="Natural disaster strikes" isInterrupting="false">
          <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_DisasterStart_SetBack</bpmn:outgoing>
          <bpmn:signalEventDefinition id="SignalEventDefinition_NaturalDisaster" signalRef="Signal_NaturalDisaster"/>
        </bpmn:startEvent>
        <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_SetBotBack" name="Set bot back after disaster">
          <bpmn:incoming>Flow_DisasterStart_SetBack</bpmn:incoming>
          <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SetBack_DisasterEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
        </bpmn:serviceTask>
        <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_DisasterHandled" name="Disaster setback applied">
          <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SetBack_DisasterEnd</bpmn:incoming>
        </bpmn:endEvent>
        <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DisasterStart_SetBack" sourceRef="StartEvent_NaturalDisaster" targetRef="Task_SetBotBack"/>
        <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SetBack_DisasterEnd" sourceRef="Task_SetBotBack" targetRef="EndEvent_DisasterHandled"/>
      </bpmn:subProcess>

      <bpmn:subProcess id="EventSubProcess_Milestone" name="Notify on milestone" triggeredByEvent="true">
        <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Milestone">
          <bpmn:lane id="Lane_MilestoneBot" name="Farming bot">
            <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_Milestone</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
            <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_NotifyMilestone</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
            <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_MilestoneNotified</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
          </bpmn:lane>
        </bpmn:laneSet>
        <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Milestone" name="Milestone reached" isInterrupting="false">
          <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_MilestoneStart_Notify</bpmn:outgoing>
          <bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition id="ConditionalEventDefinition_Milestone">
            <bpmn:condition xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">milestoneReached</bpmn:condition>
          </bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition>
        </bpmn:startEvent>
        <bpmn:task id="Task_NotifyMilestone" name="Notify player">
          <bpmn:incoming>Flow_MilestoneStart_Notify</bpmn:incoming>
          <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Notify_MilestoneEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
        </bpmn:task>
        <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_MilestoneNotified" name="Player notified">
          <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Notify_MilestoneEnd</bpmn:incoming>
        </bpmn:endEvent>
        <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MilestoneStart_Notify" sourceRef="StartEvent_Milestone" targetRef="Task_NotifyMilestone"/>
        <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Notify_MilestoneEnd" sourceRef="Task_NotifyMilestone" targetRef="EndEvent_MilestoneNotified"/>
      </bpmn:subProcess>

      <bpmn:subProcess id="EventSubProcess_UpdateList" name="Update farming list" triggeredByEvent="true">
        <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_UpdateList">
          <bpmn:lane id="Lane_UpdatePlayer" name="Player">
            <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_UpdateList</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
            <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_UpdateList</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
            <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_UpdateApplied</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
          </bpmn:lane>
        </bpmn:laneSet>
        <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_UpdateList" name="Farming list update requested" isInterrupting="false">
          <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_UpdateStart_UpdateList</bpmn:outgoing>
          <bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition id="ConditionalEventDefinition_UpdateList">
            <bpmn:condition xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">farmingListUpdateRequested</bpmn:condition>
          </bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition>
        </bpmn:startEvent>
        <bpmn:userTask id="Task_UpdateList" name="Update list of materials to farm">
          <bpmn:incoming>Flow_UpdateStart_UpdateList</bpmn:incoming>
          <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_UpdateList_End</bpmn:outgoing>
        </bpmn:userTask>
        <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_UpdateApplied" name="Farming list updated">
          <bpmn:incoming>Flow_UpdateList_End</bpmn:incoming>
        </bpmn:endEvent>
        <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_UpdateStart_UpdateList" sourceRef="StartEvent_UpdateList" targetRef="Task_UpdateList"/>
        <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_UpdateList_End" sourceRef="Task_UpdateList" targetRef="EndEvent_UpdateApplied"/>
      </bpmn:subProcess>

      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FarmingStart_Farm" sourceRef="StartEvent_Farming" targetRef="Task_FarmResources"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Farm_CompletionCheck" sourceRef="Task_FarmResources" targetRef="Gateway_FarmingComplete"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FarmingDone" sourceRef="Gateway_FarmingComplete" targetRef="EndEvent_Farming">
        <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">allSelectedResourcesGathered</bpmn:conditionExpression>
      </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FarmingRepeat" sourceRef="Gateway_FarmingComplete" targetRef="Task_FarmResources"/>
    </bpmn:subProcess>

    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_PostActions" name="Choose post-farming actions" default="Flow_PostActions_None">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Farming_PostActions</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PostActions_Brag</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PostActions_SendMaterials</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PostActions_None</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:inclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_Brag" name="Brag to selected friends" messageRef="Message_Brag">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PostActions_Brag</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Brag_PostActionsJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendMaterials" name="Send materials to selected friends" messageRef="Message_Materials">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PostActions_SendMaterials</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SendMaterials_PostActionsJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_PostActionsJoin" name="Post-farming actions complete">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Brag_PostActionsJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SendMaterials_PostActionsJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PostActions_None</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PostActionsJoin_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:inclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_ProcessComplete" name="Process complete">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PostActionsJoin_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_ChooseResources" sourceRef="StartEvent_CreateBot" targetRef="Task_ChooseResources"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ChooseResources_SetPriorities" sourceRef="Task_ChooseResources" targetRef="Task_SetPriorities"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SetPriorities_DefineDependencies" sourceRef="Task_SetPriorities" targetRef="Task_DefineDependencies"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DefineDependencies_Farming" sourceRef="Task_DefineDependencies" targetRef="SubProcess_Farming"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Farming_PostActions" sourceRef="SubProcess_Farming" targetRef="Gateway_PostActions"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PostActions_Brag" sourceRef="Gateway_PostActions" targetRef="Task_Brag">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">bragSelected</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PostActions_SendMaterials" sourceRef="Gateway_PostActions" targetRef="Task_SendMaterials">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">materialsToSend</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PostActions_None" sourceRef="Gateway_PostActions" targetRef="Gateway_PostActionsJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Brag_PostActionsJoin" sourceRef="Task_Brag" targetRef="Gateway_PostActionsJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SendMaterials_PostActionsJoin" sourceRef="Task_SendMaterials" targetRef="Gateway_PostActionsJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PostActionsJoin_End" sourceRef="Gateway_PostActionsJoin" targetRef="EndEvent_ProcessComplete"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_FarmingBot">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_FarmingBot" name="Farming Bot process" processRef="Process_FarmingBot"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Friends" name="Selected friends"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Brag" name="Brag" sourceRef="Task_Brag" targetRef="Participant_Friends" messageRef="Message_Brag"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Materials" name="Materials" sourceRef="Task_SendMaterials" targetRef="Participant_Friends" messageRef="Message_Materials"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
</bpmn:definitions>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  targetNamespace="https://example.com/bpmn/farming-bot">
  <bpmn:signal id="Signal_NaturalDisaster" name="Natural disaster"/>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_FarmingBot" name="Farming Bot" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_FarmingBot">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Player" name="Player">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_CreateBot</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ChooseResources</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SetPriorities</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_DefineDependencies</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SelectFriends</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_PostActions</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Brag</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendMaterials</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_PostActionsJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_ProcessComplete</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_FarmingBot" name="Farming bot">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>SubProcess_Farming</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_CreateBot" name="Create custom farming bot">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Start_ChooseResources</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ChooseResources" name="Choose resources to farm">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Start_ChooseResources</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ChooseResources_SetPriorities</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SetPriorities" name="Set resource priorities">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ChooseResources_SetPriorities</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SetPriorities_DefineDependencies</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_DefineDependencies" name="Define resource and tool dependencies">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SetPriorities_DefineDependencies</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_DefineDependencies_Farming</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:subProcess id="SubProcess_Farming" name="Farm resources">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_DefineDependencies_Farming</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Farming_SelectFriends</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Farming">
        <bpmn:lane id="Lane_FarmingBot_Work" name="Farming bot">
          <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_Farming</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
          <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CollectResources</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
          <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_FarmingComplete</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
          <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_Farming</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
          <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EventSubProcess_NaturalDisaster</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
          <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EventSubProcess_Milestone</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
          <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EventSubProcess_UpdateList</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        </bpmn:lane>
      </bpmn:laneSet>

      <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Farming" name="Start farming">
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_FarmingStart_Collect</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:startEvent>
      <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_CollectResources" name="Collect resources in parallel">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_FarmingStart_Collect</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_FarmingRepeat</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Collect_CompletionCheck</bpmn:outgoing>
        <bpmn:multiInstanceLoopCharacteristics isSequential="false">
          <bpmn:loopCardinality xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">min(numberOfSelectedResources, 10)</bpmn:loopCardinality>
        </bpmn:multiInstanceLoopCharacteristics>
      </bpmn:serviceTask>
      <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_FarmingComplete" name="Farming finished?" default="Flow_FarmingRepeat">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Collect_CompletionCheck</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_FarmingDone</bpmn:outgoing>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_FarmingRepeat</bpmn:outgoing>

      <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Farming" name="Farming finished">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_FarmingDone</bpmn:incoming>

            <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_NaturalDisaster</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
            <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ApplySetback</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
            <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_DisasterHandled</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
          </bpmn:lane>
        </bpmn:laneSet>
        <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_NaturalDisaster" name="Natural disaster strikes" isInterrupting="false">
          <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Disaster_Setback</bpmn:outgoing>
          <bpmn:signalEventDefinition id="SignalEventDefinition_NaturalDisaster" signalRef="Signal_NaturalDisaster"/>
        </bpmn:startEvent>
        <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_ApplySetback" name="Set bot back">
          <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Disaster_Setback</bpmn:incoming>
          <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Setback_DisasterEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
        </bpmn:serviceTask>
        <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_DisasterHandled" name="Disaster setback applied">
          <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Setback_DisasterEnd</bpmn:incoming>
        </bpmn:endEvent>
        <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Disaster_Setback" sourceRef="StartEvent_NaturalDisaster" targetRef="Task_ApplySetback"/>
        <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Setback_DisasterEnd" sourceRef="Task_ApplySetback" targetRef="EndEvent_DisasterHandled"/>
      </bpmn:subProcess>

      <bpmn:subProcess id="EventSubProcess_Milestone" name="Notify on milestone" triggeredByEvent="true">
        <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Milestone">
          <bpmn:lane id="Lane_MilestoneBot" name="Farming bot">
            <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_Milestone</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
            <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_NotifyPlayer</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
            <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_MilestoneNotified</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
          </bpmn:lane>
        </bpmn:laneSet>
        <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Milestone" name="Milestone reached" isInterrupting="false">
          <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Milestone_Notify</bpmn:outgoing>
          <bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition id="ConditionalEventDefinition_Milestone">
            <bpmn:condition xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">milestoneReached</bpmn:condition>
          </bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition>
        </bpmn:startEvent>
        <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_NotifyPlayer" name="Notify player">
          <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Milestone_Notify</bpmn:incoming>
          <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Notify_MilestoneEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
        </bpmn:serviceTask>
        <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_MilestoneNotified" name="Player notified">
          <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Notify_MilestoneEnd</bpmn:incoming>
        </bpmn:endEvent>
        <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Milestone_Notify" sourceRef="StartEvent_Milestone" targetRef="Task_NotifyPlayer"/>
        <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Notify_MilestoneEnd" sourceRef="Task_NotifyPlayer" targetRef="EndEvent_MilestoneNotified"/>
      </bpmn:subProcess>

      <bpmn:subProcess id="EventSubProcess_UpdateList" name="Update farming list" triggeredByEvent="true">
        <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_UpdateList">
          <bpmn:lane id="Lane_UpdatePlayer" name="Player">
            <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_UpdateList</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
            <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_UpdateList</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
          </bpmn:lane>
          <bpmn:lane id="Lane_UpdateBot" name="Farming bot">
            <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ApplyUpdatedList</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
            <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_UpdateApplied</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
          </bpmn:lane>
        </bpmn:laneSet>
        <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_UpdateList" name="Farming list update requested" isInterrupting="false">
          <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Update_StartTask</bpmn:outgoing>
          <bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition id="ConditionalEventDefinition_UpdateList">
            <bpmn:condition xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">farmingListUpdateRequested</bpmn:condition>
          </bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition>
        </bpmn:startEvent>
        <bpmn:userTask id="Task_UpdateList" name="Update list of materials to farm">
          <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Update_StartTask</bpmn:incoming>
          <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Update_Apply</bpmn:outgoing>
        </bpmn:userTask>
        <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_ApplyUpdatedList" name="Apply updated farming list">
          <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Update_Apply</bpmn:incoming>
          <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Apply_UpdateEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
        </bpmn:serviceTask>
        <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_UpdateApplied" name="Updated list applied">
          <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Apply_UpdateEnd</bpmn:incoming>
        </bpmn:endEvent>
        <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Update_StartTask" sourceRef="StartEvent_UpdateList" targetRef="Task_UpdateList"/>
        <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Update_Apply" sourceRef="Task_UpdateList" targetRef="Task_ApplyUpdatedList"/>
        <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Apply_UpdateEnd" sourceRef="Task_ApplyUpdatedList" targetRef="EndEvent_UpdateApplied"/>
      </bpmn:subProcess>

      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FarmingStart_Collect" sourceRef="StartEvent_Farming" targetRef="Task_CollectResources"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Collect_CompletionCheck" sourceRef="Task_CollectResources" targetRef="Gateway_FarmingComplete"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FarmingDone" sourceRef="Gateway_FarmingComplete" targetRef="EndEvent_Farming">
        <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">farmingComplete</bpmn:conditionExpression>
      </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FarmingRepeat" sourceRef="Gateway_FarmingComplete" targetRef="Task_CollectResources"/>
    </bpmn:subProcess>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SelectFriends" name="Select friends">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Farming_SelectFriends</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SelectFriends_PostActions</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_PostActions" name="Choose post-farming actions">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SelectFriends_PostActions</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PostActions_Brag</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PostActions_Materials</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:inclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_Brag" name="Brag to selected friends">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PostActions_Brag</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Brag_PostActionsJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SendMaterials" name="Send materials to selected friends">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PostActions_Materials</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Materials_PostActionsJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_PostActionsJoin" name="Post-farming actions complete">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Brag_PostActionsJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Materials_PostActionsJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PostActionsJoin_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:inclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_ProcessComplete" name="Process complete">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PostActionsJoin_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_ChooseResources" sourceRef="StartEvent_CreateBot" targetRef="Task_ChooseResources"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ChooseResources_SetPriorities" sourceRef="Task_ChooseResources" targetRef="Task_SetPriorities"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SetPriorities_DefineDependencies" sourceRef="Task_SetPriorities" targetRef="Task_DefineDependencies"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DefineDependencies_Farming" sourceRef="Task_DefineDependencies" targetRef="SubProcess_Farming"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Farming_SelectFriends" sourceRef="SubProcess_Farming" targetRef="Task_SelectFriends"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SelectFriends_PostActions" sourceRef="Task_SelectFriends" targetRef="Gateway_PostActions"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PostActions_Brag" sourceRef="Gateway_PostActions" targetRef="Task_Brag">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">bragSelected</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PostActions_Materials" sourceRef="Gateway_PostActions" targetRef="Task_SendMaterials">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">materialsSelected</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Brag_PostActionsJoin" sourceRef="Task_Brag" targetRef="Gateway_PostActionsJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Materials_PostActionsJoin" sourceRef="Task_SendMaterials" targetRef="Gateway_PostActionsJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PostActionsJoin_End" sourceRef="Gateway_PostActionsJoin" targetRef="EndEvent_ProcessComplete"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

rules.instruction: When the description says an event can occur while work is ongoing and affect that work: Model the event handling within the affected process scope, using an appropriate boundary event or event subprocess. Keep sequence flows within the same process or subprocess scope; use message flows for interactions between separate participants.
rules.situation: the description says an event can occur while work is ongoing and affect that work

rules.instruction: When the description says an activity is repeated until a stated condition is met: Model a decision after the repeated activity, routing the unmet condition back to repeat the activity and the met condition onward.
rules.situation: the description states that an ongoing phase may continue until a completion condition is met, and that later actions occur only after completion.

rules.instruction: Use short, faithful labels in the input language. Prefer verb-object activity names and meaningful business triggers or outcomes for events.
rules.situation: the description states an activity, outcome, or qualifier that distinguishes what is being done

rules.instruction: When the description assigns a person to configure or initiate work that is then performed by an automated system: Model the person and system as lanes within the same participant pool, and place the process start event in the lane responsible for initiating the work.
rules.situation: the description assigns a person to configure or initiate work that is then performed by an automated system

rules.instruction: When the description states an initiating goal or intent, followed by preparatory work that must happen before the primary operation begins: Represent the initiating goal or intent with a start event, and model each stated preparatory action as an activity before the primary operation.
rules.situation: the description states an initiating goal or intent, followed by preparatory work that must happen before the primary operation begins

rules.instruction: When the description states a specific activity or process-ending outcome: Label the corresponding BPMN activity or end event with a concise phrase that preserves the stated action or outcome; do not substitute a related action or add an unsupported one.
rules.situation: the description states an activity or outcome with an identifiable action or scope

rules.instruction: When the description indicates that a decision or synchronization follows an activity: Connect the activity to the appropriate gateway, and connect each gateway branch to its stated continuation or outcome.
rules.situation: the description indicates that a decision, branch, or synchronization is followed by a specified continuation

rules.instruction: When the description focuses on one participant’s workflow and mentions an outside party only as the recipient or source of requests, payments, or responses, without describing that party’s own process: Model the described workflow within its participant pool; do not add a separate pool or message flows solely to represent those mentions. Represent relevant receipt or decision points within the described process.
rules.situation: the description identifies a person who selects or initiates work carried out by an automated system and mentions other participants only as recipients of its outputs
